title: Pint-sized gains: the Australian brewers crafting refreshingly sustainable beers
summary: As the weather warms up, renewable and refillable brews can help reduce the environmental cost of a cold one Change by degrees offers life hacks and sustainable living tips each Saturday to help reduce your household’s carbon footprint Got a question or tip for reducing household emissions? Email us at changebydegrees@theguardian.com It’s no secret that Australians love getting on the beers : we consume 69m litres of the stuff every year. With that comes a significant packaging and environmental footprint, as commercially produced drinks generate emissions in both production and transportation. Australians drink and dispose of an estimated 17bn bottles and cans a year , fewer than half of which are recycled. Continue reading...
author: Jack Larkin
